name: Oghma Stone Script
loreTies: The living world adapts and endures.
Living Grove: terrain and sustain effects grow stronger over time.
Oghma Stone Script is a colossal Tuatha Titan shaped by the living world adapts and endures. It manifests the Realm's law through battlefield-scale mythic force.
shortBackstory: Oghma Stone Script is a Tuatha Guardian whose Gate scar links Avalora to The First Reopening; their power expresses the living world adapts and endures under campaign pressure.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Oghma Stone Script began as more than a weapon in Avalora. Oghma Stone Script was bound to a living grove scar in Avalora during a Gate disturbance that tested whether the living world adapts and endures could survive contact with the Hollow. The title carried in their name was earned when the Titan chose duty over spectacle and accepted a burden ordinary soldiers could not survive.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Tuatha, Oghma Stone Script is treated as proof that an ancient civilization intertwined with sacred forests, fae danger, living stones, druidic force, and moonlit grove law can become battlefield doctrine without losing its soul. Their silhouette carries emerald, silver, living wood, ancient stones, roots, bark-bronze skin, antler crowns, moonlit grove power, but their real identity is tactical: adaptation, healing, roots, terrain control, endurance through life systems. Every deployment makes faction philosophy visible through movement, restraint, and force.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Gate did not simply attack Oghma Stone Script; it tried to measure what their Realm values most. The wound echoed sacred doctrine back as bait, tempting the Titan to overextend, break formation, or turn culture into raw fuel. Oghma Stone Script survived by refusing the Gate's terms, leaving a scar that still reacts whenever adaptive roots appears on the map.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In The First Reopening, Oghma Stone Script gives the campaign a personal lens on faction survival. Their presence reinforces the rule that faction identity stays distinct unless a mission explicitly permits otherwise. In a 5-Titan squad, Oghma Stone Script turns Living Grove from a passive rule into a story statement: the Realm is defending its meaning.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Oghma Stone Script's flaw is overcommitment to the belief that their Realm's answer must always be enough. NPC witnesses and rival factions challenge that certainty as the Hollow learns to imitate law, oath, balance, life, radiance, and ambition without understanding any of them. Their battlefield stats support this arc: HP 40, attack 5, range 3, speed 2, energy 3.

relationshipHooks: Cross-faction envoys can challenge their doctrine without erasing their faction identity.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
